description: Inspect the agent harness installation, shared skills, docs, and native Codex/Claude integration status.
name: harness_inspect

description: Run a read-only git preflight for the atomic-commit-push workflow: branch/upstream, staged/unstaged/untracked files, secret-like paths, and commit style hints.

path.description: Git repository path. Defaults to the agent project directory.

name: atomic_commit_preflight

description: Return the Conventional Commit + Lore body policy used by this harness.
name: commit_policy

description: List shared skills exposed by the harness and their metadata.
name: skill_manifest

description: Return a lightweight index of AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GENIUS_THINK.md, and agent_docs markdown files: relative path, title, headings, and byte size.
name: docs_index

description: Evaluate whether an argv-based command request is allowed by the harness command policy without executing it.

argv.description: Command argv array. Shell strings are not accepted.

cwd.description: Command working directory; must be inside workspace_root.

shell_allowed.description: Whether shell interpreter argv[0] is allowed.

shell_reason.description: Required reason when shell_allowed is true.

name: command_policy_check

description: Run the command policy and return a fake runner result. This never executes the command; it only proves policy acceptance/denial and audit metadata.

argv.description: Command argv array. Shell strings are not accepted.

cwd.description: Command working directory; must be inside workspace_root.

shell_allowed.description: Whether shell interpreter argv[0] is allowed.

shell_reason.description: Required reason when shell_allowed is true.

name: command_fake_run

description: Write a small agent state checkpoint to HARNESS_STATE_DIR or ~/.local/state/agent-harness. Keys allow [A-Za-z0-9._-] and cannot contain path traversal.

key.description: State key, max 128 chars, no path separators.

name: state_write

description: Read an agent state checkpoint by key.
name: state_read

description: List agent state checkpoint keys and metadata.
name: state_list

description: Prune old agent state checkpoints. Defaults to dry-run; pass confirm=true to delete records older than max_age.

confirm.description: When true, delete matching records; false or omitted performs a dry-run.

max_age.description: Duration such as 720h or 168h. Must be positive.

name: state_prune

description: Inspect agent state checkpoint files for invalid JSON, key mismatches, byte-count drift, invalid timestamps, and unexpected files without modifying state.
name: state_doctor

description: Migrate valid legacy state checkpoints to the current schema. Defaults to dry-run; pass confirm=true to rewrite eligible records.

confirm.description: When true, rewrite legacy records; false or omitted performs a dry-run.

name: state_migrate

description: Report whether the shared agent-harness daemon backing this MCP proxy is reachable, including socket and pid metadata.
name: daemon_status

description: Plan the 자가 증강 루프: use GENIUS_THINK.md, repo signals, and research-backed strategies to choose concrete feature/performance/quality improvements. The native skill performs implementation; this tool exposes the scoring contract and candidate curriculum, and can persist the chosen plan to harness state for durable Reflexion-style memory.

cycles.description: Number of autonomous improvement cycles to plan; defaults to 1.

save_state.description: When true, save the selected self-augmentation plan to harness state.

state_key.description: State key for save_state; defaults to self-augment-latest.

target_score.description: Exclusive per-goal score threshold; defaults to 95.

name: self_augment

description: Store a Reflexion-style 자가 증강 lesson in harness state for durable cross-session learning.

candidate_id.description: Candidate id this lesson belongs to; defaults to current selected open candidate.

lesson.description: Lesson learned from failure, QA issue, or design concern.

next_action.description: Specific next action that should use this lesson.

severity.description: info, warning, or error. Defaults to info.

source.description: Source that produced the lesson; defaults to self-augment.

name: self_augment_lesson

description: Run the 자기 검증 루프: at least 10 seeded iterations of tests, risk-tier QA, build, CLI/MCP schema and response contract golden checks, command policy, MCP, state roundtrip, native integration, and git preflight fuzz checks. Termination requires every concrete goal score to be greater than target_score.

iterations.description: Iteration count; must be at least 10.

save_state.description: When true, save compact summary to harness state after the run.

seed.description: Base seed for deterministic per-iteration fuzz fixtures.

state_key.description: State key for save_state; defaults to self-verify-latest.

target_score.description: Exclusive per-goal score threshold; defaults to 95.

name: self_verify

description: Export the 자기 검증 루프 improvement candidate curriculum, including open/satisfied IDs and the next selected candidate.

save_state.description: When true, save the candidate export snapshot to harness state.

state_key.description: State key for save_state; defaults to self-verify-candidates-latest.

name: self_verify_candidates

description: List saved 자기 검증 루프 summary checkpoints from harness state, sorted by snapshot generation time for quick baseline/candidate discovery.

confirm.description: When true with prune_retention, delete retention candidates beyond retention_limit.

limit.description: Maximum entries to return; defaults to 20, 0 returns all.

prefix.description: State key prefix to scan; defaults to self-verify. Use empty string to scan all keys.

prune_retention.description: When true, plan retention pruning. This is a dry-run unless confirm is also true.

retention_limit.description: Maximum matching summaries to retain by newest-first ordering. Omit or use 0 to disable retention planning.

name: self_verify_history

description: Compare two saved 자기 검증 루프 summary checkpoints from harness state and report elapsed-time, failed-step, step-label, and goal-score regressions.

baseline_key.description: State key containing the baseline self-verification summary snapshot.

candidate_key.description: State key containing the candidate self-verification summary snapshot.

max_elapsed_regression_pct.description: Allowed elapsed_ms increase percentage before regression; defaults to 20.

name: self_verify_compare

description: Promote a saved 자기 검증 루프 summary checkpoint to a baseline state key. Defaults to dry-run; pass confirm=true to write the baseline.

baseline_key.description: State key to write as the promoted baseline.

confirm.description: When true, write baseline_key; false or omitted performs a dry-run.

from_key.description: State key containing the candidate self-verification summary snapshot to promote.

name: self_verify_promote
